question: The doctor feels our heartbeats with the help of an instrument called _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**stethoscope**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **stethoscope** is an acoustic medical device used by healthcare professionals for **auscultation**, which involves listening to the internal sounds of a human or animal body.
 
• The instrument is primarily used to listen to the **heartbeat** and **lung sounds**, providing critical information about the rhythm of the heart and the clarity of the airways.
 
• It was invented in **1816** by the **French** physician **René Laennec** at the **Necker-Enfants Malades Hospital** in **Paris**. Originally, it was a simple wooden tube.
 
• Modern stethoscopes consist of a **chest piece** (comprising a **diaphragm** and a **bell**), **tubing**, and **earpieces**. The **diaphragm** is used for high-frequency sounds, while the **bell** is used for low-frequency sounds.
